description: This file defines the OfficeNotFoundException class, which extends a platform-specific exception for handling cases where an office resource is not found in the system. It provides constructors for different scenarios involving invalid office identifiers.
external_methods: super(String messageCode, String defaultMessage, Object... args)
super(String messageCode, String defaultMessage, Object id, Throwable cause)

classes.name: OfficeNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an office resource was not found, extending a generic resource not found exception.

methods.name: OfficeNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for a missing office with the given ID.

methods.name: OfficeNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor for wrapping an underlying data access exception when an office with the given ID is not found.

methods.name: OfficeNotFoundException(ExternalId externalId)
methods.description: Constructor for a missing office identified by an external ID.

calls: super("error.msg.office.id.invalid", "Office with identifier " + id + " does not exist", id)
super("error.msg.office.id.invalid", "Office with identifier " + id + " does not exist", id, e)
super("error.msg.office.external.id.invalid", "Office with external identifier " + externalId + " does not exist", externalId)
